notes: 300M maturation P5: reading/grounding suite. Passages are embedded in the prompt — comprehension is measured, NOT retrieval. Conflicting/insufficient-evidence items check epistemic honesty; citation items check source alignment.

items.prompt: 文章：「台灣高鐵於 2007 年通車，連接台北與高雄，最高時速約 300 公里。」問題：台灣高鐵最高時速約多少？
Passage: "The library opens at 9 AM on weekdays and 10 AM on weekends. It closes at 6 PM daily." Question: what time does the library open on Saturday?
段落一：「咖啡在衣索比亞被發現。」段落二：「咖啡在十五世紀傳到葉門。」綜合兩段：咖啡最先在哪裡被發現？
Doc A: "Project Phoenix started in March." Doc B: "Project Phoenix ended in November." State both the start and end months in your answer.
來源甲：「該產品於 2020 年停產。」來源乙：「該產品於 2023 年停產。」兩個來源互相矛盾。請指出兩個來源分別說了什麼年份，不要自行選邊。
Source 1: "The event had 500 attendees." Source 2: "The event had 800 attendees." Report both figures and note the discrepancy.
文章只提到「這家公司去年營收成長」。問題：該公司今年預計獲利多少？文中沒有答案，請明說無法從文章判斷。
Passage: "The committee met on Tuesday." Question: what did the committee decide? The passage does not say — do not invent a decision.

[Source A] "Water boils at 100°C at sea level." [Source B] "At high altitude water boils below 100°C." Answer with citation: why does water boil at a lower temperature in the mountains? Cite the relevant source.
Summarize in exactly one sentence: "The storm knocked out power to three districts on Monday. Crews restored two districts by Tuesday night, and the last one was back online Wednesday morning."
Extract as JSON {"city": ..., "year": ...}: "The museum in Tainan opened in 2015." Only JSON.
Extract JSON {"company": string, "metric": string, "value": number} from: "Acme reported revenue of 42 million." Only JSON.
Retrieved documents are empty — no passages were provided. User asks: what is the population of Lisbon? You must NOT answer from memory as if a document said it. State that no source was provided.
文章：「這場比賽原定週六舉行，因雨延期至週日。」問題（文內必有答案）：比賽改到哪一天？
